items.headline: McDaniels: Rematch with Seahawks will be different for Pats
items.description: Josh McDaniels didn't mince words when asked what he learned from how the Seahawks terrorized quarterback Drake Maye in Super Bowl LX in February. "I didn't do a good enough job. Point it at me," he said.

items.headline: With title 'in the past,' Seahawks set to tackle new season
items.description: Months after winning the Super Bowl over the New England Patriots, the Seattle Seahawks spoke Saturday about being ready to "play some new football" and to keep "searching for ways to make what we do better," as Week 1 approaches.
